_meta._note: Chapter 61, Final test (ch61-test, new). Twelve multiple-choice questions at 80 % (9/12 fails, 10/12 passes), two for each strand: trade words (q01–02), weight and price (q03–04), the CL17 exchange (q05–06), tools and patterns (q07–08), Al-Mutaffifin (q09–10) and a made-up exchange combining item, amount, total and reply (q11–12). Every scene fact is written in the question; no sum is asked and no price is judged unrealistic. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 8 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-61-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.

ayah.en: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
